components.name: Product Card • Hover Image
components.description: A shop product as a card linking to its page: its photo, swapped for its second photo on hover, a Sale badge while it's on sale, name, short description, price and was price.

children.text: Twin-face sheepskin with a light, cushioned sole.

components.name: Product Card • Quick Add
components.description: A shop product as a card that buys in place: its photo on a soft well, name and price linking to its page, a short description, a picker per option and an add to cart button.

children.text: Twin-face sheepskin with a light, cushioned sole.

components.name: Product Card • Compact
components.description: A shop product in a single row for cross-sells: a small photo, name and price linking to its page, and an add button.

components.name: Product Card • Featured
components.description: One shop product as a large card: a tag, its name, short description, price, add to cart and a link to its page.

children.text: Twin-face sheepskin with a light, cushioned sole.

components.name: Product List • Grid • 4 Column • Hover Image
components.description: Shop products in a four-column grid of hover-image cards.

components.name: Product List • Scrolling Row • Hover Image
components.description: Shop products in a row that scrolls sideways, four cards and the edge of the next in view.

components.name: Product List • Grid • 4 Column • Quick Add
components.description: Shop products in a four-column grid of cards that add to the cart in place.

components.name: Product List • Compact • 3 Column
components.description: Shop products as compact single-row cards, three across.

components.name: Product List • Featured
components.description: One shop product, as a featured card.

components.name: Category Tile • Image
components.description: A link to a part of the shop as a tall photo with its name and a call to action on a gradient at its foot.

components.name: Category Tile List • Grid • 4 Column
components.description: Image tiles linking to parts of the shop, four across.

components.name: Benefit Item
components.description: A shop promise: an icon, a short title and a line under it.

components.name: Benefit List • Strip • 4 Column
components.description: Shop promises in a ruled strip, four across.

components.name: Review Card
components.description: A customer's review: stars, a title, the review and who wrote it.

children.text: Arrived quickly and looks even better than the photos. The quality is obvious the moment you unbox it.

components.name: Review List • 3 Column
components.description: Customer reviews, three across.

children.text: I was unsure about ordering online, but the fit is perfect and returns were easy to understand.
Lovely finish and well packed. Took a few days longer than expected to arrive.

components.name: Products • Scrolling Row
components.description: A heading with a "View all" link over a sideways-scrolling row of shop products with hover images, for new arrivals or best sellers on the home page and below a product.

components.name: Products • Grid • Quick Add
components.description: A heading over a grid of shop products that shoppers add to the cart without leaving the page, picking an option on the card when the product has them.

components.name: Product • Featured on Photo
components.description: A large photo with one shop product on a floating card over it: a tag, its name, short description, price, and buttons to add it to the cart or see more. For launching a product on the home page.

components.name: Categories • Image Tiles
components.description: A heading over tall photo tiles, each linking to a part of the shop with its name on the photo. Photos and links are chosen per tile.

components.name: Benefits • Strip
components.description: A ruled strip of the shop's promises (delivery, returns, warranty, payment), each an icon, a title and a line. For the foot of the home page or under a product.

components.name: Category • Banner, Links and Products
components.description: A category page: a breadcrumb, the category's name and description on a photo banner, a row of links to related parts of the shop, then a grid of its products with hover images and a Load more button.

components.name: Products • Pair It With
components.description: A heading over compact cards of products related to the page's product, each with its own add button, on a tinted band. For a product page's cross-sell.

components.name: Product • Sticky Buy Bar
components.description: A bar that stays at the foot of the screen on a product page: the product's photo, name and price, quantity and add to cart, so shoppers can buy from anywhere on the page. Place it last on the page.

components.name: Reviews • Score and Cards
components.description: The shop's or a product's review score: the average, its stars, the review count and a five-row histogram, beside three review cards. Written in the Editor; the shop has no reviews yet.

componentMemory.label: productImageAlt
componentMemory.description: The product's second photo, shown while the card is hovered.
